title: Why You Don't Consciously Think To Ride a Bike
hook: Your brain performs complex actions without you even knowing it.

narration.text: When you ride a bike, you are not consciously thinking about every muscle movement.
This happens thanks to something called procedural memory.
It is a type of long-term memory for performing different actions and skills.
Procedural memory allows us to do things automatically, like walking or typing.
Your brain has learned the sequence of movements and stores them efficiently.
This frees up your conscious mind to focus on other things, like traffic.
It is why you can ride a bike after many years without practice.
What other skills do you perform without thinking?

description: Ever wondered how you can ride a bike or type without consciously thinking about every movement? It is all thanks to procedural memory. This video explains how your brain stores and retrieves automatic skills.
topic: Why you can ride a bicycle without consciously thinking about every movement, explaining procedural memory.
